execution_order.name: Refresh installed metadata then native isolated-data/XDG baselines in November
Fedora desktop Debian/WPS and Arch/Zoom first; Fedora/WPS RPM moved to eligible non-Fedora desktop, remaining 9 cells follow readiness
execution_order.fixture_policy: Derive allowed targets from policy v2 on each real host. Current Fedora/Ubuntu/Debian/Arch hosts each admit exactly two catalog targets. One environment per target per installation root, including retained/adopted/missing records; shared source fixtures run sequentially after CLI bootstrap fixtures. Separate roots do not waive host policy. Cleanup to each captured baseline.

additional_local_trials.purpose: same-build native Fedora host versus Fedora guest on another eligible desktop; record host differences, not a same-host pure overhead A/B
additional_local_trials.policy_note: LOCAL is a preserved historical ID and installer location, not permission to create Fedora on Fedora

additional_local_trials.purpose: local DEB source/format-limited enterprise app trial; source URL authenticity not established by filename/header

product_adapter_gate.required_action: Separate native GIO baselines and unified product routing subcases. Implement adapter before claiming host/Flatpak managed routing; do not block native baseline or guest-only routing.
product_adapter_gate.latest_cli_scope: per-target internal app identity and alias; full desktop entry argv; no automatic handler/menu export

global_default_policy: Read and preserve current defaults; first use isolated XDG/test data. For later real journaled changes preserve exact before/after and restore or report conflict; do not uninstall native apps as a test shortcut.
observation_policy: Historical versions, default associations, paths and installer hashes must be revalidated at execution; source pages not refreshed for this revision.
